# .github/workflows/resident-android.yml
- Lines: 615 | Kind: push/dispatch/nightly workflow (packaged-runtime APK build, unsigned update candidate, two emulator suites, embedding qualification publication) | Verdict: KEEP, SPLIT/SIMPLIFY
- Covers: builds the PACKAGED resident runtime APK archives (distribution + test-mocks), on main push an unsigned native update candidate (`app-update-candidate.ts version/receipt/archive-size`), on dispatch producer evidence for the protected Cloud signing workflow, then runs `resident-native.py` and `pending-recovery-ui.py` on emulators; `operation: publish-qualification` instead calls `embedding-qualification-carrier.yml`. Duplicates: `android.yml` (toolchain, vendor test :272), `resident-prepare.yml` (`agent:prepare`, `test-resident-phase.py`), `test/python-suites.test.mjs` (`resident-crash-diagnostic.test.py`, `test-recovery-ui-guard.py`, `test-pending-recovery-phases.py`), `android-emulator.yml` (emulator block). Callers/importers: push main (always) and develop (var-gated), cron 06:23 (var-gated), dispatch; artifact name consumed by `scripts/ci/verify-cloud-signing-input.sh`; YAML parsed by Quint harnesses `specs/quint/refinement/services/app-update-candidate.mjs:19` and `protected-app-update-promotion.mjs:17,36-40` (asserts env condition and step order); listed as manifest `sources` in `specs/quint/services/manifest.json:2878,2924`; text read by `test/ci-required-checks.test.mjs:77`, `test/embedding-workflow-forwarding.test.mjs:5`, `test/app-update-candidate.test.mjs:210`, `test/pilot-units.test.mjs`, `test/hosted-native-inputs.test.py`, `test/python-suites.test.mjs` (comment); named in `scripts/app-update-candidate.ts`, `scripts/generate-licenses.ts`, `scripts/qualify-head.ts`, `scripts/owner/emulator-campaign-check.ts`, `affected.ts:38`.
- Health: 0 green in last 40; longest build failed after 66 min (51 min in "Stage and archive"); main push costs build 180 + native 100 + recovery-ui 55 min budgets.

## Proposed end state
- `resident-android.yml`: `build` job (composite toolchain/free-disk/node, native-input acquisition when candidate, `agent:prepare`, worker build + its flow tests, `agent:stage-android`, `build-archive.ts` distribution and, off main push, test-mocks), candidate binding and uploads via scripts; `native` and `recovery-ui` jobs use the shared emulator composite and run on dispatch/nightly only.
- Embedding qualification publication is its own dispatch workflow.
- No host unit tests, vendor tests, inline heredocs or capacity-validation ceremony; target ≈250 lines.
- Quint harnesses depend on the scripts, not on this YAML.
